backend/main.mo: Motoko canister providing posts CRUD, media attachments, user profiles, and access‑controlled admin/user operations.
feature_evidence.json: Evidence report listing feature IDs, related frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Mapping of frontend file paths to short human‑written summaries describing their roles in the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light/dark modes with global styling utilities.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes for home, post detail, and admin pages with AppLayout and admin guarding.
frontend/src/components/AdminPostMediaMa: Admin component for uploading, previewing, expanding/collapsing, and removing post media attachments.
Wrapper that blocks non‑admins from viewing admin pages, showing loading or access‑denied UI.
frontend/src/components/AllowlistManager: UI for granting, revoking, and checking access for principals using validation and backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: App wrapper providing theme, navigation, footer, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AsyncState.tsx: Displays an error state with retry support for async operations.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login/logout with status awareness and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/MediaGallery.tsx: Renders image and video attachments with expandable image previews.
frontend/src/components/MediaUploader.ts: Uploads image or video files to a post with progress, success, and error states.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: Top navigation bar with routing, admin links, mobile menu, and auth button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminStatus.ts: Checks if the authenticated caller is an admin using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login/clear functions, and context management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend post and access operations with create, read, update, delete, and access control mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark theme variables, typography, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin interface for creating, editing, deleting, and managing posts with dialogs and validation.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays all posts, handles loading and empty states, and links to admin tools for admins.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Shows full post details, locked content logic, and authentication prompts for restricted posts.
frontend/src/utils/date.ts: Formats a Unix timestamp into a readable Australia/Sydney date string.
frontend/src/utils/principal.ts: Validates Internet Identity principal strings and parses them into Principal objects.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL params (including hash routing), persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing them from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom fonts, colors, sizing, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, including goals, architecture notes, known bugs, and existing features for the journaling site.
